payload.description: A step-by-step playbook for managers and leaders inside companies where AI mandates exist but execution guidance is absent. CPA Nathan Mapp outlines exactly what to do first (document your processes, define specific problems), how to find real practitioners, how to structure expert roundtables, and why leaders must personally build with AI before expecting their teams to. Cuts through the consultant-speak and focuses on what actually works.
payload.name: The AI Implementation Playbook for Functional Leaders
payload.title: The AI Implementation Playbook for Functional Leaders
